🚨 PLTR: Earnings Today — Stock Down 33% From Highs, Poised for a 10% Swing

📰 What: Palantir reports Q2 earnings today; Yahoo flags a potential major rebound after a sharp drawdown.

💰 Value: Fwd P/E 60.2, PEG 1.76 — premium justified by +84.7% revenue growth & +325% EPS. Consensus target $182.20 = 44.6% upside. Moat: Deep gov/enterprise lock-in.

📊 Tape:
• 📉 Bearish daily/weekly/monthly; death cross (50<200 EMA), RSI 48 neutral, MACD negative. Volume falling but buyers biased.
• 🎯 Support $122.66 (-2.7%) vs Resistance $137.29 (+8.9%) — R:R 3.35. Price holding exactly at 78.6% fib ($126.17).

🎯 Verdict: Bullish (7/10). Key level: $126.17 fib — hold = bounce to $137+; break below $122.66 risks retest of $106.37. 🫧 AI bubble risk if sentiment shifts — 1.56 beta amplifies.

🚀 NVDA reclaims $2T club vibes — sector peer TSM back at $2T at ~20x fwd earnings, purest AI play stays cheap.

📰 What: TSM milestone confirms AI capex cycle intact (Yahoo). NVDA = top pick to ride it.

💰 Value: EPS +214%, rev +85%, 63% margin. Fwd P/E 16.17x, PEG 0.55 = undervalued. 58-analyst target $302.83 → 45% upside. Moat: CUDA lock-in.

📊 Tape:
• 📈 Weekly/monthly up; 50 EMA > 200 EMA. RSI 54 (neutral), MACD slightly red. Volume flat, buyers biased.
• 🎯 Support $197.32 / Resistance $214.35. R:R to resistance 0.54 — range-bound until breakout.

🎯 Verdict: Bullish 8/10. Key level: $214.35. PEG 0.55 + triple-digit EPS growth = mispriced AI king. 🫧 Bubble risk: high beta 2.21 — a capex pause could compress the multiple fast.

📰 Microsoft proved AI capex can drive profits (Yahoo). Positive read-through for Alphabet’s own massive AI outlays.

• Resistance $374.81 (R:R 0.01) · support $296.72 (-20.7%). 🫧 Stretched short-term, but weekly/monthly uptrends intact.

🚀 MSFT +5.26% to $489.17 — Blasts Through Upper Bollinger as AI-Shock Debate Heats Up

📰 What: Yahoo flags MSFT's balance sheet as AI-shock resilient vs Oracle, reinforcing quality bid amid bubble-risk chatter.

💰 Value: Fair — 17.7% rev growth, 31.7% EPS growth, 67.9% GM. Fwd P/E 20.85, PEG 1.52. Analyst target $563.05 = 15.1% upside. Moat: Strong (ecosystem lock-in).

📊 Tape:
• 🔺 Bullish daily/weekly/monthly; RSI 78.48 overbought, price above BB upper ($460.19). Volume flat, buyers.
• ⚖️ Resistance $489.75 (0.12% away) vs support $409.35 — R:R 0.01. Extreme extension, mean-reversion risk.

🎯 Verdict: Neutral (7/10) — $489.75 is the line; chasing offers 0.12% upside vs 16.32% downside. 🫧 AI-spend digestion could compress multiples despite balance-sheet strength.
